provenance: Experimental grid extending the frozen V3 candidate at tile_size_px 512 / payload_repetitions 5. V3 itself is untouched and remains the sealed reference.
hypothesis: V2 swept qim_delta 24-64 without spread spectrum and never exceeded 3/12 decode. V3 added spread spectrum (spread_delta 4.0, spread_chips_per_bit 64) and reached 9-10/12. Spread is therefore the mechanism that produced the gain, yet spread_chips_per_bit, spread_delta and the saturated_fraction_min threshold that routes tiles to the spread codec were all frozen and never swept. This grid sweeps them.
